asr.full_text: Hi there, my name is David and I will in less than 2 minutes let you in on a fantastic opportunity revolutionizing the digital currency space of today's economy. Digital currencies are clearly the future of payments online and have been one of the hottest financial topics this year. It all started back in 2008 when a revolutionary digital currency was introduced on the internet, called Bitcoin. It took only 5 years for this new currency to grow in value from 1 single cent to 1000 dollars. It is widely used and well known, thousands of people have profited from this currency and it has appreciated more than 75 times last year Bitcoin was one of the most successful financial investments of 2013 Clearly, a new era was born in digital Currences And today you have a unique chance to participate in this success through a new currency called OneCoin OneCoin is a new kind of cryptocurrency with strong values connected to innovation and profitability for holders of the coin. OneCoin will be introduced through our education programme where you learn about trading strategies and how to profit from trading with cryptocurrency. With our education packages, you will receive free trading tokens, so-called one tokens. These tokens will give you the possibility for trading in on our exchange with thousands of other members, practice your skills and let you profit from what you have learned through our oneAcademy program. The ONE tokens can be exchanged once you feel proficient enough to start trading with cryptocurrency. As a member, you will get your own back office where you will learn about the ONE Coin concept, get access to your education packages and follow the progress of the business and stay updated on the latest news follow your tokens portfolio via the back-office and see it grow through our split program the split program can double your tokens portfolio each portfolio has the chance to split up to two times this means if you are active you can increase your portfolio value in just under 10 weeks. By becoming an active marketing partner of the ONE network, and by popularizing ONE COIN, you will be able to qualify for exciting bonuses by building your own sales team. The Bonus Plan lets you chance to build a successful business or make an investment in crypto and be a founder of a successful business. The bonus plan lets you not only build a successful business but also can benefit from the big potential that can be brought to you by investing in crypto! Take a chance and register Today. today we are in our first launch face and have a limited number of positions available during this phase if you want to profit from cryptocurrency and build your future success with one coin today is your chance fill out our simple at work.

textual.observation: The speaker promotes OneCoin education packages by stating that recipients receive free trading tokens and that the tokens can later be exchanged for cryptocurrency trading.

evidence.quote: With our education packages, you will receive free trading tokens, so-called one tokens. These tokens will give you the possibility for trading in on our exchange with thousands of other members
The ONE tokens can be exchanged once you feel proficient enough to start trading with cryptocurrency.

textual.context: Promotional narration for OneCoin; the supplied records do not independently establish the package terms, exchange operation, or token value.
textual.potential_relevance: A stated benefit of free tokens is linked to obtaining education packages and participating in an exchange for cryptocurrency trading.
textual.limitations: The records do not state package prices, show an enrollment or payment flow, or establish whether tokens were exchangeable or had any realized value.

textual.observation: The speaker claims that a split program can double a member's token portfolio and says active members can increase portfolio value in under 10 weeks.

evidence.quote: the split program can double your tokens portfolio each portfolio has the chance to split up to two times this means if you are active you can increase your portfolio value in just under 10 weeks.

textual.context: Promotional narration; the statement includes the condition "if you are active" but does not define that condition in the supplied text.
textual.potential_relevance: A specified portfolio-growth claim is tied to participation in the split program and an activity condition, with a stated timeframe.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish how the split program works, what activity requires, whether the claim is guaranteed, or whether any portfolio value can be redeemed.

textual.observation: The speaker says becoming an active marketing partner and popularizing OneCoin can qualify a participant for bonuses by building a sales team.

evidence.quote: By becoming an active marketing partner of the ONE network, and by popularizing ONE COIN, you will be able to qualify for exciting bonuses by building your own sales team.

textual.context: Promotional narration describing a marketing-partner and sales-team structure.
textual.potential_relevance: The stated eligibility for bonuses is linked to becoming a marketing partner, promoting OneCoin, and building a sales team.
textual.limitations: The records do not specify bonus amounts, eligibility rules, compensation mechanics, whether recruitment is required, or any participant outcomes.

textual.observation: The description directs viewers to register for free through a OneCoin signup URL, while the narration says positions in the launch phase are limited and urges registration.

visual.observation: A branded presentation states that one token is earned through an academy program, alongside OneCoin/One Network branding.
visual.context: Promotional presentation context; a presenter appears beside the on-screen claim.
visual.potential_relevance: The visible claim links receiving a token to participation in an academy program under the displayed OneCoin/One Network branding.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show the academy's full terms, any payment requirement, how the token is obtained, its value, or whether a viewer actually participates.

visual.observation: The presentation states, "YOU CAN INCREASE YOUR PORTFOLIO VALUE IN JUST UNDER 10 WEEKS" and "SPLIT UP TO 2 TIMES."
visual.context: Promotional presentation context; the statements are displayed beside a chart-like graphic.
visual.potential_relevance: A stated portfolio-value increase is tied to a specific timeframe and a stated opportunity to split up to two times.
visual.limitations: The visible text does not specify an amount, guarantee, eligibility criteria, underlying asset terms, or what action is required.

visual.observation: The presentation says viewers can qualify for "EXCITING BONUSES" by building their own sales team.
visual.context: Promotional presentation context under One Network branding.
visual.potential_relevance: The displayed bonus claim is explicitly connected to a recruitment-related action: building a sales team.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show bonus values, qualification rules, whether recruitment is compensated, or any actual payment or transfer.

visual.observation: A registration call to action is shown with "TAKE YOUR CHANCE" and "REGISTER TODAY," followed by a screen stating, "FILL OUT OUR SIMPLE REGISTRATION FORM AND JOIN" beside a visible form interface.
visual.context: Promotional presentation context; the form is visually presented as part of the One Network material.
visual.potential_relevance: The visible prompt combines an immediate registration request with a form interface and the preceding offers involving tokens, portfolio value, and bonuses.
visual.limitations: The form fields and any submitted information are not fully legible, and the frames do not establish that registration was completed, what data is required, or any subsequent outcome.

visual_context_notes.observation: The sampled frames present the material as a polished promotional video with a suited presenter and OneCoin/One Network branding.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin as a way to profit from cryptocurrency, claiming that a split program can double a token portfolio and increase its value in under 10 weeks. It directly urges viewers to register while also tying bonuses to building a sales team, making the solicitation depend on both token-return claims and recruitment.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S05 fits because the video promotes OneCoin tokens and links participation to portfolio growth and rapid doubling claims. S06 is separately supported because qualification for bonuses is explicitly tied to building a sales team and popularizing the coin.
